en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing part of a Gothic-style building façade. Three tall pointed arches dominate the view; the central arch is filled with several rows of small, light-colored bells forming a carillon or glockenspiel, while the two side arches contain decorative stone tracery. The masonry has contrasting lighter mortar lines that emphasize the gothic arch shapes. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.
